verses.text: Mu mwaka ugira gatatu umwami Yehoyakimu w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, ni ho Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yaja gutera i Yerusalemu arahugariza.
Umwami Imana amuha kunesha Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda kandi yemera ko na bimwe mu bikoresho vyejejwe vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana abinyaga. Nebukadineza abitwara i Babiloni abishira mu nzu y’imana yiwe.
Hanyuma umwami ategeka Ashipenazi, umukuru w’abakozi bo ku kirimba iwe, kumuzanira bamwe bo mu Bisirayeli bakomoka mu miryango y’abami n’iy’abubahwa,
abasore b’amagara meza, b’akaranga, bashoboye kwiga ningoga, bafise impano y’ubwenge no gutahura kandi bashoboye gukora ku kirimba i bwami. Yategerezwa kubigisha ururimi n’ivyanditswe vy’i Babiloni.
Umwami ategeka ko babagaburira ku vyo asanzwe afungura, bakanywa no ku muvinyu asanzwe anywa. Bategerezwa kumara imyaka itatu bigishwa, hanyuma bagaca batangura gukora i bwami.
Mu basore bahisemwo, harimwo Daniyeli, Hananiya, Mishayeli na Azariya, bose bava i Buyuda.
Umukuru w’abakozi b’i bwami abaha ayandi mazina: Daniyeli amwita Beluteshaza, Hananiya amwita Shadarake, Mishayeli amwita Meshake, Azariya na we amwita Abedinego.
Maze Daniyeli agira imigabo yo kutihumanisha ivyokurya n’umuvinyu vy’umwami, aca asaba umukuru w’abakozi b’i bwami ngo amwemerere kutavyihumanisha.
Imana iha Daniyeli gutona no gukundwa n’uwo mukuru w’abakozi b’i bwami.
Ariko abwira Daniyeli ati: “Umwami databuja ni we yategetse ivyo murya n’ivyo munywa. Niyabaraba agasanga muronze ntimusa n’abandi basore mungana, ndatinya ko azonca umutwe.”
Nuko Daniyeli aca avugana n’uwari abajejwe, uwo umukuru w’abakozi b’i bwami yari yahaye igikorwa co gukurikirana Daniyeli, Hananiya, Mishayeli na Azariya, amubwira ati:
“Turagusavye utugerageze imisi cumi, utureke turye imboga, tunywe n’amazi.
Inyuma y’iyo misi uzorabe ingene tuzoba dusa utugereranije n’abandi basore barya ivyokurya vy’umwami. Hanyuma uzotugenze uko uzoba ubona bikwiye ukurikije ivyo uzoba wabonye.”
Uwo yari abajejwe aravyemera, aca afata imisi icumi yo kubageza.
Iyo misi icumi iheze, Daniyeli na bagenziwe baboneka bavyibushe, bafise amagara meza kandi basa neza kurusha ba basore bandi barya ivyokurya vy’umwami.
Kuva ico gihe, umwe abajejwe aca abemerera kwama barya imboga, ntiyongera kubahatira ku vyokurya n’umuvinyu bari bategekanirijwe.

Imana iha abo basore bane kumenya no gutahura inyandiko z’uburyo bwinshi kandi zitandukanye no kugira ubwenge. Daniyeli we yarashobora gutahura no gusobanura ivyahishuwe mw’iyerekwa n’indoto z’uburyo bwose.
Igihe co kwiga cashinzwe n’umwami kirangiye, wa mukuru w’abakozi b’i bwami ajana ba basore imbere ya Nebukadineza.
Umwami avugana na bo bose, ariko nta n’umwe yabonetse anganya ubwenge na Daniyeli, na Hananiya, na Mishayeli na Azariya. Nuko baca bakora ku kirimba i bwami.
Igihe cose umwami ababajije ikintu ico ari co cose cerekeye ubwenge no gutahura, yama asanga barusha abanyamareba n’abapfumu bose bo mu bwami bwiwe incuro icumi.
Nuko Daniyeli aguma akorera ku kirimba i bwami kugeza mu mwaka wa mbere w’ingoma y’umwami Kuro.
Mu mwaka ugira kabiri ari ku ngoma, Nebukadineza yagize indoto zikomeye zituma vyanka ko asubira gusinzira.
Aca atumako abanyamareba, abapfumu, abarozi n’abaragurisha kuraba inyenyeri, kugira ngo bamubwire ivyo yarose. Bashitse imbere yiwe,
arababwira ati: “Narose indoto kandi yambujije amahoro. Ngomba kumenya ico isobanura.”
Abaragurisha kuraba inyenyeri baramwishura bati: “Mwami nyaguhoraho, tubwire iyo ndoto twebwe abasavyi bawe, natwe turaheza tukubwire insobanuro yayo.”
Umwami yishura abaragurisha kuraba inyenyeri ati: “Ng’iyi ingingo nafashe: nimutambwira indoto narose n’insobanuro yayo, muratemagurwa kandi n’inzu zanyu ndazihindura imisaka.
Ariko nimwambwira iyo ndoto n’ingene isobanurwa, ndabaha ingabire nyinshi n’icubahiro cinshi. Nimumbwire rero indoto narose n’ico isigura!”
Na bongera kwishura umwami bati: “Nyeningoma, ehe tubwire twebwe abasavyi bawe ivyo warose, hanyuma tukumenyeshe ingene bisobanurwa.”
Umwami arabishura ati: “Ndabona ko muriko muragerageza kuraba ko umwanya woba urahera, kuko mubona ko namaze gufata ingingo.

Ariko nimutambwira ivyo narose, mwese murindiriwe n’igihano kimwe. Mwamaze kuja inama mbi yo kumbesha, mwibaza ko mpava mpindura ingingo nafashe. Ubu rero mimumbwire indoto narose, hanyuma nca menya ko mushobora no kumbwira uko isobanurwa.”

Abo baragurisha kuraba inyenyeri baramwishura bati: “Nta muntu n’umwe kw’isi ashobora gukora ivyo umwami adutegetse! Kandi nta mwami, uko yoba ahambaye kwose akaba n’agakomeye, yosaba ikintu nk’ico umunyamareba, umupfumu n’uwuragurisha kuraba inyenyeri n’umwe!
Ivyo umwami asavye ntibishoboka. Nta muntu n’umwe yoshobora kukubwira ivyo warose atari imana, kandi izo na zo ntizibana n’abantu.”
Umwami aca arashavura cane, mbere aca ategeka ko ba kamenyi bose b’i Babiloni bicwa.
Icagezwe c’umwami kimaze gutangazwa ko ba kamenyi bose bicwa, baca barungika abantu kurondera Daniyeli na bagenziwe ngo na bo bicwe.
Igihe Ariyoki, umukuru w’abacungera umutekano w’umwami yari agiye kwica ba kamenyi, Daniyeli amenya ingene amuvugisha mu bwenge n’ubwitonzi.
Abaza Ariyoki umukuru w’abacungera umutekano w’umwami ati: “Mbega ni kuki umwami yatanze itegeko riteye ubwoba nk’iryo?” Ariyoki aca amusigurira ivyabaye vyose.
Ako kanya Daniyeli aca aja kuraba umwami kugira ngo amusabe umwanya wo kwitegura, hanyuma aze amusobanurire iyo ndoto.
Daniyeli arataha, abwira bagenziwe Hananiya, Mishayeli na Azariya ivyabaye.
Arabahimiriza ngo basenge cane basabe Imana nyene ijuru ibagirire ubuntu ibamenyeshe iryo banga, kugira ngo ntibicanwe n’abandi ba kamenyi b’i Babiloni.
Iryo joro nyene, Daniyeli ahishurirwa iryo banga mu buryo bw’inzozi. Daniyeli aca ahimbaza Imana yo mw’ijuru,
avuga ati: “Izina ry’Imana rishirwe hejuru ibihe vyose, ubwenge n’ubushobozi ni ivyayo.
Ni yo igera ingene ibihe bikuranwa; ikuraho abami, ikimika abandi. Iha ubwenge abanyabwenge n’ugutahura abakurondera.
Ni yo ihishura ibihishijwe, ikamenya ibiri mu mwijima kandi umuco ubana na yo.
Ndagutazira kandi ndaguhimbaza, Mana ya ba sogokuruza, kuko wampaye ubwenge n’ubushobozi, ukampa kumenya ivyo twakubajije, ukatumenyesha indoto y’umwami.”

Maze Daniyeli aca aja kuraba Ariyoki, uwo umwami yari yatumye kwica ba kamenyi b’i Babiloni. Aramubwira ati: “Ntiwice ba kamenyi b’i Babiloni, njana iyo umwami ari ndamumenyeshe ico indoto yiwe isigura.”
Ariyoki aca ajana Daniyeli iyo umwami ari yihuta, abwira umwami ati: “Naronse umwe mu banyagano b’Abayuda ashobora kukumenyesha ico indoto warose isigura.”
Umwami abaza Daniyeli, uwo bise Beluteshaza, ati: “Ni ivy’ukuri ko ushobora kumbwira indoto narose n’ingene isobanurwa?”
Daniyeli yishura umwami ati: “Nta muntu n’umwe yaba kamenyi, umupfumu, umunyamareba canke uwuragura yoshobora kukumenyesha iryo banga;

ariko hariho Imana iba mw’ijuru ishobora guhishura amabanga. Ni yo yahishuriye umwami Nebukadineza ibizoba muri kazoza. Indoto yawe hamwe n’ivyo weretswe vyaciye mu mutwe wawe igihe wari uryamye ku buriri bwawe ni izi:
Nyeningoma, igihe wari usinziriye, warose ivyerekeye ibihe bizoza kandi iyihishura amabanga yakweretse ibizoba mu gihe kiri imbere.

Ku binyerekeye, iryo banga sinarihishuriwe kubera ndusha abandi ubwenge, ariko ni kubera Imana igomba ko wewe Nyeningoma umenya ico indoto warose isigura kandi utahure ivyiyumviro vyatumye uhagarika umutima.
Nyeningoma, mu ndoto yawe wabonye igishushanyo kinini gisa n’umuntu gikayangana kandi giteye ubwoba gihagaze imbere yawe.
Umutwe w’ico gishusho wari ugizwe n’inzahabu nziza, amaboko n’igikiriza vyari bigizwe n’ifeza, inda n’urukenyerero vyari bigizwe n’umwakaka,
amaguru yaco yari agizwe n’ivyuma, ibirenge vyaco na vyo bikaba vyari bigizwe n’icuma kivanze n’ibumba.
Uriko uraraba, wabonye ibuye ridatewe n’umuntu n’umwe rivudutse ku musozi, riraza rikubita ibirenge vya ca gishusho bigizwe n’icuma kivanze n’ibumba, rirabijanjagura.

Nuko ca cuma na rya bumba, wa mwakaka, ya feza na ya nzahabu vyose bihinduka umukungugu, umuyaga uraza urabitumura, aho vyahora ntihasigara n’akamenyetso kavyo. Ariko iryo buye ryamenaguye ico gishusho rica rirakura, rivamwo umusozi munini wuzura isi yose.
Iyo ni yo ndoto yawe, ubu na ho ngira ndakubwire uko isobanurwa.
Nyeningoma, wewe uri umwami ahambaye cane mu bandi bami bose. Imana yo mw’ijuru yaguhaye ububasha bwinshi, ubushobozi, inkomezi n’icubahiro.
Yaguhaye gutegeka ahantu hose haba abantu, mbere n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba n’inyoni ibishira musi y’ubutware bwawe. Ni wewe rero uri uwo mutwe w’inzahabu w’ico gishusho.
Inyuma y’ubwami bwawe, hazoza ubundi bwami butazoba buhambaye nk’ubwawe, hanyuma haze n’ubwa gatatu bugereranywa n’umwakaka kandi na bwo butegeke isi yose.
Hanyuma hazoza ubwami bugira kane, buzoba bukomeye nk’icuma, buzomenagura busanzaze ubwami bwose bwabwitangiye imbere, kurya ivyuma bimenagura bigasanzaza ikintu cose.

Ibirenge n’amano wabonye, vyari bigizwe n’icuma kivanze n’ibumba, vyerekana ko ubwo bwami buzoba butagira ubumwe; ariko buzoba burimwo ubushobozi nk’ubw’icuma, nk’uko wabonye icuma cari kivanze n’ibumba.
Ariko nk’uko mu mano igice kimwe cari kigizwe n’icuma ikindi kigizwe n’ibumba, ubwo bwami hamwe buzoba bufise inkomezi, ahandi buzoba bufise intege nke.

Kandi nk’uko wabonye icuma cari kivanze n’ibumba, ni ko abantu b’ubwo bwami bazogerageza kugiriranira amasezerano yo kwifatanya. Ariko kurya icuma bidashobora gufatana neza n’ibumba, ni ko bitazokunda ko bwifatanya.
Ku ngoma z’abo bami, Imana yo mw’ijuru izokwihagurukiriza ubwami butazokwigera burangira canke ngo bukurweho n’ubundi. Buzorandura ubwo bwami bwose buburangize, ariko bwo buzokwamaho ibihe bidashira.

Insobanuro y’ivyo ni ibuye wabonye riva ku musozi kandi ridatewe n’ukuboko kw’umuntu n’umwe, rikikubita kuri ca gishusho, rikamenagura icuma, umwakaka, ibumba, ifeza n’inzahabu. Imana ihambaye yeretse umwami ibizoba mu gihe kiri imbere. Iyo ndoto ni iy’ukuri kandi insobanuro yayo ni iyo kwizerwa.”
Umwami Nebukadineza aca yikubita hasi yubamye imbere ya Daniyeli, amuha icubahiro cinshi, atanga itegeko ngo bamubagire ibimazi bongere bamuturirire ibimota neza.
Umwami abwira Daniyeli ati: “Ni ukuri, Imana yawe ni yo Mana iri hejuru y’ivyitwa imana vyose, iganza abami bose igahishura ibihishijwe, kuko washoboye guhishura iryo banga.”
Hanyuma umwami aca aha Daniyeli ikibanza c’icubahiro, amuha n’ubundi bushimwe bwinshi, amuha kuganza abahanuzi b’umwami bose bo mu ntara ya Babiloni.
Vyongeye, abisabwe na Daniyeli, umwami aha Shadarake, Meshake na Abedinego gutegeka intara yose ya Babiloni. Daniyeli we aguma ku kirimba i bwami.

Umwami Nebukadineza yacurishije igishusho mu nzahabu gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu z’ubwaguke, hanyuma ategeka ko bagishinga mu kiyaya c’i Dura, mu ntara ya Babiloni.
Aca ahamagaza abaganwa biwe, abatware, abacamanza, abanyabigega n’abandi batware bose bo mu ntara, ngo baze ku musi mukuru wo gushikiriza abantu ico gishusho yashinze.
Nuko abaganwa biwe, abatware, abacamanza, abanyabigega n’abandi batware bose bo mu ntara baraza, bahagarara imbere y’ico gishusho.
Hanyuma, uwujejwe ivyo birori aca arasemerera cane n’ijwi rirengera avuga ati: “Yemwe bantu bo mu mahanga yose, indimi zose, n’amoko yose, ng’ibi ivyo mutegerezwa gukora:

Mucumva inzamba, imyironge, ikembe, inanga, imiduri n’ibindi bikoresho vyose bicurarangwa, bisamiranye, muce mwikubita hasi mwubamye, kugira ngo musenge ico gishusho c’inzahabu umwami Nebukadineza yashinze.
Umuntu wese ataja kwikubita hasi ngo asenge ico gishusho, aca afatwa atererwe mw’itanure ry’umuriro uhinda.”
Maze, abo mu mahanga yose n’indimi zose n’amoko yose bumvise amajwi y’ivyo bicurarangisho, baca bikubita hasi imbere y’ico gishusho baragisenga, ico umwami Nebukadineza yari yahagaritse.
Ivyo biheze, bamwe mu baragurisha kuraba inyenyeri baca baja kuraba umwami ngo bamubwire ivyerekeye Abayuda banse kwikubita imbere y’ico gishusho.
Babwira umwami bati: “Umwami aragahora ku ngoma ibihe vyose!
Nyeningoma, wari watanze itegeko ribwira abantu bose ko bacumva amajwi y’inzamba, imyironge, imiduri, amakembe n’ibindi bicurarangisho baca bapfukamira igishusho washinze bakagisenga.
Kandi itegeko ryawe rivuga ko uwutumvira iryo tegeko aca atabwa mw’itanure ry’umuriro uhinda.

Ariko rero, Nyeningoma, hariho Abayuda bamwe, ari bo Shadarake, Meshake na Abedinego, abo wahaye gutwara intara y’i Babiloni, batakwubaha na gatoya. Banse gusaba imana zawe kandi ntibemera gusenga igishusho cawe c’inzahabu wahagaritse.”
Maze umwami Nebukadineza ararakara cane, ategeka ko bazana ningoga Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego. Baca barabazana.
Arababaza ati: “Ni ivy’ukuri ga Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego ko mwanse gukorera imana zanje no gusenga igishusho c’inzahabu nahagaritse?

Ubu rero, mukimara kwumva amajwi y’inzamba, imyironge, amakembe, inanga, n’imiduri n’ibindi bicurarangisho vyose, muce mupfukama musenge ico gishusho. Mutabikoze, muca mutererwa mw’itanure ry’umuriro uhinda. Mbega ni iyihe mana yoshobora kubakura mu kuboko kwanje?”
Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego baramwishura bati: “Nyeningoma Nebukadineza, ntibikenewe ko twisigura kuri ivyo.
Nimba duterewe mw’itanure ry’umuriro uhinda, Imana dukorera irashobora kuturokora muri iryo tanure ry’umuriro uhinda, kandi iraturokora idukure mu bubasha bwawe, Nyeningoma.
Ariko n’aho itobikora, twagomba tukumenyeshe neza, Nyeningoma ko tudashobora gukorera imana zawe kandi ko tudashobora gusenga igishusho c’inzahabu washinze.”
Nebukadineza arakarira cane Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego, mu maso hiwe harahinduka, aca ategeka ko bacanira itanure incuro indwi kurusha uko ryahora
hanyuma aca ategeka abasoda biwe bakomeye gufata Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego, kubaboha no kubaterera muri iryo tanure ry’umuriro uhinda.
Nuko barabafata babaterera muri iryo tanure ry’umuriro bambaye amakanzu, amapantaro, imyitwikiro n’ibindi vyo gushaza.

Kandi kubera yuko umwami mu burake bwiwe yategetse ko itanure baricanira incuro indwi kurenza uko ryahora, imbeya z’umuriro w’iryo tanure ziturira abasoda bagiye guterera Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego muri ryo.
Abo bagabo batatu, uko nyene baboshwe, bagwa muri iryo tanure ry’umuriro uhinda.
Mu nyuma, umwami Nebukadineza aca ava hasi atangaye cane, abaza abahanuzi biwe ati: “Mbega harya abantu twaboshe tugaterera mw’itanure si batatu?” Baramwishura bati: “Egome, ni uko Nyeningoma.”
Aca avuga ati: “Raba! Jewe mbonayo abantu bane bagendagenda mu muriro, bataboshe kandi ata na kimwe babaye, kandi uwugira kane asa n’umwana w’imana!”

Nebukadineza aca aragenda yegera ku muryango w’iryo tanure hanyuma arasemerera cane ati: “Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego, basavyi b’Imana Musumbavyose, nimusohoke! Nimuze hano!” Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego baca barasohoka bava muri iryo tanure.

Abaganwa biwe, abajejwe urugo rwiwe, abatware n’abahanuzi biwe bose baraza barabashengerera. Baravye basanga umuriro ntiwigeze ubaturira na gatoya, ndetse n’umushatsi wabo nta co wigeze uba, impuzu zabo ntizahiye kandi babimotereje basanga nta n’umwotsi banuka.

Maze Nebukadineza aca avuga ati: “Imana ya Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego, iragahezagirwa kuko yarungitse umumarayika wayo gukiza aba basavyi bayo bayizigiye! Banse, kwumvira amategeko yanje, bemera gutanga imibiri yabo ngo iturirwe aho gukorera no gusenga iyindi mana itari Imana yabo.

Kuva ubu rero, ntanze iri tegeko ko umuntu wo mw’ihanga iryo ari ryo ryose canke w’ururimi urwo ari rwo rwose, azogira ijambo ribi avuga ku Mana ya Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego, azohimbagurwamwo ibihimba, kandi inzu yiwe ihinduke umusaka, kuko nta yindi mana ishobora gukiza nk’uku!”
Hanyuma umwami aha icubahiro gikomeye mu kazi kabo Shadarake, Meshake, na Abedinego, mu ntara ya Babiloni.

headings.text: Abanse gusenga igishusho c’inzahabu batererwa mu muriro uhinda

verses.text: Umwami Nebukadineza arungika ubu butumwa ati: Ku mahanga yose n’abantu bavuga ururimi rwose, baba kw’isi yose: “Amahoro n’iterambere bibe muri mwebwe!”
Binteye umunezero kubamenyesha ivyerekeye ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso, n’utwumiza Imana Musumbavyose yankoreye.
Mbega ukuntu ibimenyetso vyayo bikomeye; n’ubushobozi buri mu bitangaza vyayo! Ubwami bwayo ni ubw’ibihe bidashira; kandi inganji yayo yamaho uko urunganwe rukurikirana n’urundi.
Jewe, Nebukadineza, nari ku kirimba iwanje, nguwe neza kandi nteye imbere.
Hanyuma ijoro rimwe ndarota kandi iyo ndoto yanteye ubwoba bwinshi. Nari ndyamye ku buriri bwanje; hanyuma nerekwa ibintu vyandanduye umutima.
Maze, nca ntanga itegeko ryo guhamagaza abanyabwenge bose b’i Babiloni ngo baze bambwire ico iyo ndoto ivuga.
Igihe abanyamareba, abapfumu, abaragurisha kuraba inyenyeri, abahamagara imizimu baza, nta n’umwe yashoboye kumbwira ico isobanura.
Mu nyuma, ni ho Daniyeli ari we Beluteshaza yaza, ansobanurira ivy’iyo ndoto. Iryo zina yarihawe kubera ryegeranye n’izina ry’imana yanje, ariko impwemu y’imana zitagira agasembwa iba muri we.

Ndamubwira nti: “Beluteshaza, mukuru w’abapfumu bose, ndazi neza ko impwemu y’imana zitagira agasembwa iri muri wewe kandi ko ata binyegejwe wewe udashobora kumenya. Iyi ni yo ndoto yanje, mbwira rero uko isobanurwa.
Igihe nari ndyamye ku buriri bwanje, nabonye igiti kinini cane kiri hagati kw’isi.
Ico giti kirakura kiba kinini kandi kiba kirekire, gikora ku bicu ku buryo umuntu wese aho ari kw’isi hose yashobora kukibona.

Cari gifise amababi meza n’ivyamwa vyinshi ku buryo abantu bose bashobora kubiryako. Ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba vyaraza bikibera mu gitutu caco, inyoni na zo zikarika mu mashami yaco. Icaremwe cose cashobora kurya ivyamye kuri co.
Mu vyo neretswe, nkiryamye kuri ubwo buriri, mbona imbere yanje hari intumwa yejejwe imanutse iva mw’ijuru.

Ica ivuga n’ijwi rirenga iti: ‘Icira ico giti, mugikureko n’amashami yaco, mugikunkumure kandi ivyamwa vyaco mubisanzaze, hanyuma mwirukane ibikoko biri mu gitutu caco hamwe n’inyoni ziri mu mashami yaco.
Igishitsi caco n’imizi mubireke, ariko mubiboheshe iminyororo y’ivyuma n’iy’imiringa, ivyatsi bitotahaye bikirenge hejuru. Mukireke gitondweko n’urume ruva kw’ijuru, kibane n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba.
Kandi mu gihe kingana n’imyaka indwi, ntikize congere kugira ivyiyumviro nk’ivy’abantu, ariko kigire ivyiyumviro nk’ivy’ibikoko.

Iyo ngingo yatangajwe n’intumwa, ku rubanza ruciwe n’uwejejwe, kugira ngo umuntu wese ahumeka amenye ko Imana Musumbavyose, iri hejuru y’ingoma zose zo kw’isi kandi yimika uwo ishatse, ikamushira hejuru yazo, naho yoba ari uwo musi y’abandi bose.’

Iyo ni yo ndoto, Jewe umwami Nebukadineza nagize. Ubu rero, wewe Beluteshaza, mbwira uko isobanurwa, kuko nta n’umwe wo mu banyabwenge bose bo mu bwami bwanje, ashobora kuyinsobanurira. Ariko, nzi neza ko wewe ushobora gutahura ico ivuga, kuko impwemu y’imana zitagira agasembwa iri muri wewe.”

Maze Daniyeli ari we bise Beluteshaza aca amara umwanya mu gacerere arengewe n’ivyiyumviro. Ariko, umwami aramubwira ati: “Ntuterwe ubwoba n’iyo ndoto canke ukwo isobanurwa.” Na we aca ambwira ati: “Nyeningoma, ese icompa ivyo iyo ndoto ivuga bikaba ku bansi n’insiguro yayo ikaba ku bakugwanya!”
Ico giti wabonye cakuze cane kandi kigakomera, kikaba kirekire ku buryo gikora kw’ijuru kigashobora kubonwa n’abari kw’isi yose,
amababi yaco yari meza cane kandi kigatanga ivyamwa bikwiye ku vyaremwe vyose, ibikoko bikibera mu gitutu caco kandi n’inyoni zikarika mu mashami yaco.
Nyeningoma, ico giti ni wewe. Wabaye uwuhambaye n’uwukomeye, icubahiro cawe gishika kw’ijuru kandi ubwami bwawe bwuzuye isi yose.

Nyeningoma wabonye uwutagira agasembwa amanuka avuye mw’ijuru azanye ubutumwa, avuga ati: “Ico giti nimucicire mugihonye! Ariko igishitsi caco n’imizi mubirekere mw’ivu, biboheshejwe iminyororo y’ivyuma n’iy’imiringa. Mukirekere mu vyatsi bitotahaye, kimare imyaka indwi gitondwako n’urume.”
Nyeningoma, iyi ni yo nsobanuro, Imana Musumbavyose yatanze itegeko kuri wewe mwami Nyeningoma:

uzokurwa mu bantu uje kubana n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba; uzorisha ivyatsi nk’inka, utondweko n’urume rwo kw’ijuru. Ibihe indwi bizokuranwa kuri wewe, kugeza aho uzotahurira ko Iyisumbavyose ari yo iganza ubwami bwose bwo mw’isi, ikabuha uwo ishatse wese.
Itegeka ko igishitsi n’imizi babireka. Ivyo bisobanurwa ko uzosubira ku ngoma yawe, umaze gutahura ko Imana yo mw’ijuru ari yo iganza vyose.

Nuko, Nyeningoma, ndagusavye wakire impanuro ndaguhaye: “Uve mu vyaha vyawe utangure kubaho mu bugororotsi; ugirire imbabazi abahahazwa. Ni ho ivyawe bizogenda neza, ugatera imbere ikindi gihe kirekire.”
Ivyavuzwe ku mwami Nebukadineza vyaramushitseko vyose.
Inyuma y’amezi icumi n’abiri, yariko agendagenda hejuru ku kirimba i Babiloni,
maze aravuga ati: “Mbega aha si i Babiloni, igisagara gihambaye ahari ikirimba niyubakiye n’ubushobozi bwanje ngo kimpeshe icubahiro?”
Ayo majambo akiva mu kanwa kiwe, haza ijwi rivuye mw’ijuru rimubwira riti: “Mwami Nebukadineza, iyi ni yo ngingo yafashwe kuri wewe, ububasha buva ku ngoma urabwatswe.

Uzokurwa mu bantu hanyuma uje kubana n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba; aho uzorisha ivyatsi nk’inka. Uzomara imyaka indwi ibihe bigukuranwako, kugeza igihe uzotahurira ko Imana Musumbavyose ari yo iganza ingoma zose zo kw’isi kandi ko ingoma yose iyiha uwo ishatse.”

Ubwo nyene, ivyari vyavuzwe kuri Nebukadineza vyaciye bishika. Yaciye akurwa mu bantu, hanyuma arisha ubwatsi nk’inka. Umubiri wiwe utondwako n’urume rwo kw’ijuru kugeza aho umushatsi wiwe wakuze ukamera kurya kw’amoya y’inkona n’inzara ziwe zirakura zimera nk’iz’inyoni.

Iyo myaka indwi iheze, jewe Nebukadineza, narangamije mw’ijuru, ubwenge buragaruka. Maze nca ntangura gutazira no gushima Iyisumbavyose no guha icubahiro Ibaho ibihe bitazoshira. Inganji yayo ntizorangira, kandi ingoma yayo izohoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rusubirira urundi.

Abantu bose bo kw’isi, baboneka bameze nk’ubusa. Ikora ivyo ishatse, n’ubushobozi bwo mw’ijuru hagati mu bantu bo kw’isi. Nta muntu n’umwe ashobora gufata ukuboko kwayo, canke ngo ayibaze ati: “Mbega aho wakoze iki?”

Uwo mwanya nyene nasubijwe ubwenge, nsubizwa n’ubwiza n’icubahiro vyanje, kugira ngo ingoma yanje igire ubwiza. Abahanuzi n’abandi banyacubahiro banje baca barandondera hanyuma nsubizwa ku ngoma yanje, mbere nca mba uwuhambaye kurusha uko nari imbere y’aho.
Ubu rero, jewe Nebukadineza, ndahimbaza kandi ngaha icubahiro nongera nshima Umwami wo mw’ijuru. Kuko ibikorwa vyiwe ni ivy’ukuri kandi biragororotse, ashobora no gucisha bugufi abibone bose.
Hashize imyaka myinshi, umwami Belushaza agirira umusi mukuru abantu igihumbi bo mu baganwa n’abatware biwe, basangira umuvinyu.

Igihe Belushaza yariko aranywa uwo muvinyu, aca atanga itegeko ngo bazane ibikombe bikozwe mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza, ivyo se Nebukadineza yari yaranyaze mu rusengero i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo we, abaganwa n’abatware biwe, hamwe n’abagore n’incoreke ziwe babinyweshe.
Nuko, bazana ivyo bikombe bikozwe mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza vyanyazwe mu rusengero rw’Imana i Yerusalemu, umwami, abaganwa n’abatware biwe, abagore biwe n’incoreke barabinywesha.
Bariko baranywa, bahimbaza ibigirwamana vyabo bikozwe mu nzahabu, mw’ifeza, mu mwakaka, mu vyuma, mu biti no mu mabuye.
Ubwo nyene, umwami aja abona igikonjo kiriko kirandika ibintu ku gihome cera kiri impande y’igiterekwako amatara.
Akibonye, afatwa n’ubwoba bwinshi, mu maso harahinduka. Amavi yiwe arakomangana kubera kudegezwa, kandi amaguru yiwe acika intege.

Umwami aca arasemerera ngo bamuzanire abapfumu, abaragurisha kuraba inyenyeri n’abahamagara imizimu. Maze aca abwira abo banyabwenge b’i Babiloni ati: “Umuntu wese ansomera birya vyandiko akambwira n’ico bisigura, azoca yambikwa impuzu y’inyambarabami, yambikwe n’umugufu w’inzahabu mw’izosi. Azoca ahabwa ikibanza ca gatatu mu banyacubahiro bo hejuru muri ubu bwami.”
Abanyabwenge bose baraza, ariko nta n’umwe muri bo yashoboye gusoma iyo nyandiko canke kuvuga ico isobanura.
Umwami akomeza kumererwa nabi, mbere no mu maso hiwe akomeza kwiraburanirwa, kandi abanyacubahiro biwe babura ico bari bukore.

Nyina w’umwami, yumvise ijwi ry’umwami n’amajwi y’abanyacubahiro biwe, aca yihutira kuja mu cumba c’amazimano. Maze abwira umwami ati: “Umwami arakaramba! Ntugire ubwoba ngo ucike intege, kandi ntiwiraburanirwe.

Mu bwami bwawe, hariho umuntu afise impwemu y’imana zitagira agasembwa. Ku ngoma y’umwami, so, uwo mugabo yarerekanye ko afise ubumenyi n’ubwenge busa n’ubw’imana. Ni co catumye umwami so amuha kugaba abanyamareba, abapfumu, n’abaragurisha kuraba inyenyeri, n’abahamagara imizimu.

Uwo mugabo Daniyeli, uwo umwami yataziriye Beluteshaza, vyarabonetse ko afise ubushobozi budasanzwe, kandi yuzuye ukumenya no gutahura, kandi agashobora no gusobanura indoto, kumenya ibihishijwe no gutora inyishu z’ibibazo bigoye. Tumako Daniyeli, arakubwira ico iyo nyandiko ivuga.”
Nuko Daniyeli ashikanwa imbere y’umwami. Umwami aramubaza ati: “Ni wewe Daniyeli, umwe wo mu nyagano data yazanye akuye i Buyuda?
Bambwiye ko impwemu z’imana ziba muri wewe kandi ko ufise kumenya, gutahura hamwe n’ubwenge.
Abanyabwenge n’abaraguzi babazanye baragerageza kunsomera amajambo yanditswe ku gihome ariko ntibabishoboye.

Numvise rero ko wewe woshobora kunsobanurira iyo nyandiko kandi ko ushobora no gutora inyishu y’ibibazo bigoye. Hamwe woshobora kunsomera iyo nyandiko no kumbwira ico isobanura, uzokwambikwa impuzu y’icubahiro y’i bwami, wambikwe n’umugufu w’inzahabu mw’izosi, uhabwe ikibanza ca gatatu mu banyacubahiro bo hejuru muri ubu bwami.”
Daniyeli yishura umwami ati: “Ndagusomera iyo nyandiko, ndakubwire n’uko isobanurwa. Ariko ingabire zawe zigumirize canke uzihe uwundi.”
Nyeningoma, Iyisumbavyose yahaye so Nebukadineza ubushobozi, icubahiro, no kuba uwuhambaye,

Icubahiro yamuhaye catumye abantu bo mu moko yose, n’amahanga yose, n’indimi zose bajugumira imbere yiwe. Yarica abo ashatse kwica, agakiza abo agomba gukiza, kandi agaha icubahiro abo ashatse kugiha, agacisha bugufi uwo ashatse gucisha bugufi.
Ariko, igihe agiriye ubwibone mu mutima wiwe no mu vyiyumviro vyiwe, yacishijwe bugufi, yakwa ingoma yiwe n’ubwiza bw’icubahiro ciwe.

Yakuwe mu bantu, ahabwa ivyiyumviro vy’igikoko, abana n’indogoba zo mw’ishamba kandi arisha ubwatsi nk’inka; umubiri wiwe utondwako n’urume, kugeza umusi yatahuriye ko Iyisumbavyose ari yo itegeka ubwami bwose bwo kw’isi kandi ko ari yo ishira ku ngoma uwo ishatse.
“Kandi nawe Belushaza umuhungu wiwe, naho wari uzi ivyo vyose, ntiwicishije bugufi.

Ahubwo wishize hejuru imbere y’Imana yo mw’ijuru. Wategetse ko bazana ibikombe vyo mu Ngoro yiwe, kugira ngo wewe n’abanyacubahiro bawe, abagore bawe n’incoreke zawe, babinyweshe umuvinyu. Uhimbaza ibigirwamana bikozwe mu nzahabu, mw’ifeza, mu mwakaka, mu vyuma, mu biti no mu mabuye, bidashobora kubona, kwumva canke gutahura. Ariko ntiwahaye icubahiro Imana kandi ari yo ifise ubugingo bwawe mu kiganza cayo, ikanamenya kazoza kawe.
Ni co gituma Imana yatumye ico gikonjo kwandika ayo majambo.
Ibi ni vyo vyari vyanditswe: mene, mene, tekeli, parisini
Uku ni ko ayo majambo asobanurwa: Mene risobanurwa ngo ‘Imana yaharuye imyaka umaze ku ngoma, iyishizeko iherezo.’
Tekeli risobanurwa ngo ‘wapimwe ku munzane, basanga nta bilo bikwiye ufise.’
Parisini risobanurwa ngo ‘ubwami bwawe buragabuwe, buhawe Abamedi n’Abaperesi.’ ”

Ubwo nyene Belushaza aca atanga itegeko, ko bambika Daniyeli impuzu y’icubahiro y’i bwami, yambikwe n’umugufu w’inzahabu mw’izosi, kandi ko ahabwa ikibanza ca gatatu mu banyacubahiro bo hejuru muri ubwo bwami.
Iryo joro nyene, Belushaza umwami w’i Babiloni aricwa,
hanyuma Dariyusi Umumedi aca atwara ubwo bwami. Yari afise imyaka mirongo itandatu n’ibiri.
Umwami Dariyusi, atoranya abatware ijana na mirongo ibiri, umwe wese amuha intara atwara,

abo na bo abaha abakuru batatu bo kubarongora, umwe muri abo batatu akaba yari Daniyeli. Abo batware bategerezwa kwereka abo bakuru batatu ingene bakoze akazi kabo, kugira ngo barabe ntihagire ikintu na kimwe umwami ahomba.
Daniyeli akora ibikorwa vyiwe neza kurusha abandi bakuru, n’abatware bose, bituma umwami agira imigabo yo kumwegurira gutwara ubwami bwose.

Kubera ivyo, abakuru hamwe n’abatware b’intara bagerageza kurondera ikosa bokwagiriza Daniyeli bakuye mu bikorwa akora, ariko bararibura, kuko yari umwizigirwa, akirinda ingurire no kwanjanjwa ku bikorwa.
Ni ho abo bagabo bavuga bati: “Nta kirego na kimwe tuzoronka co kwagiriza Daniyeli, kiretse tukirondeye mu bijanye n’ivyagezwe vy’Imana yiwe.”
Abo bakuru hamwe n’abatware, baragenda, babwira umwami bati: “Nyaguhoraho, mwami Dariyusi!

Twebwe twese abakuru, abatware, abahanuzi, n’abakuru b’intara bose, twahuje inama yo kugusaba ngo ushireho itegeko ribuza umuntu wese gusubira gusenga iyindi mana n’imwe canke uwundi muntu n’umwe atari wewe, kumara imisi mirongo itatu. Uwuzobikora wese, azoce atererwa mu rwobo rurimwo intare.
None rero Nyeningoma, bategure iryo tegeko, hanyuma urishireko umukono kugira ngo ntirize rihinduke, kurya nyene amategeko y’Abamedi n’Abaperesi adahinduka.”
Nuko umwami Dariyusi yemeza iryo tegeko yongera arishirako umukono wiwe.

Ariko, Daniyeli yumvise ko iryo tegeko ryashinzwe, aca aja i muhira iwe, yurira mu cumba ciwe co hejuru, yugurura amadirisha atumbereye i Yerusalemu. Arapfukama arasenga, gatatu ku musi nk’uko yamenyereye, ashimira Imana yiwe.
Maze ba batware bagenda ari umugwi baja kwa Daniyeli, basanga ariko arasenga asaba Imana ngo imutabare.

Baca bagenda ubwo nyene ku kirimba kuraba umwami, bamwibutsa itegeko yashinze, bati: “Nyeningoma, burya ntiwashinze itegeko rivuga ko mu misi mirongo itatu ata muntu yemerewe gusenga iyindi mana canke uwundi muntu, atari wewe, kandi ko uwuzorirenga azoca atererwa mu rwobo rurimwo intare?” Umwami arabishura ati: “Egome, ni ko biri, kandi ni itegeko ry’Abamedi n’Abaperesi ridashobora guhinduka.”
Baca babwira umwami bati: “Daniyeli, umwe mu baje ari inyagano bavuye i Buyuda, ntakwubaha kandi ntiyubahiriza n’iryo tegeko ryawe. Akomeza gusenga Imana yiwe gatatu ku musi.”
Umwami amaze kwumva ivyo, aca arababara cane, aca agira ishaka ryo gutabara Daniyeli, agerageza uko ashobora kwose kuraba ingene yomukiza kugeza izuba rirenze.

Ku mugoroba, ba bagabo bagenda ari umugwi baja kuraba umwami, baramubwira bati: “Nyeningoma, ibuka ko nk’uko amategeko y’Abamedi n’Abaperesi ameze, ata tegeko umwami yashizeko umukono wiwe rishobora guhindurwa.”
Amaherezo umwami avuga ko bazana Daniyeli bakamuta mu rwobo rw’intare. Umwami aramubwira ati: “Ese, Imana yawe ukorera mu bwizigirwa yokurokora.”

Hanyuma, bazana ikibuye kinini co kwugaza umuryango w’urwo rwobo, umwami arushirako ikidodo ciwe n’ic’abanyacubahiro biwe, kugira ngo yemeze ko ata muntu n’umwe yemerewe guhindura ingingo yafashwe ku vya Daniyeli.
Kuva ubwo, umwami aca aja ku kirimba iwe, akesha ijoro ryose adafunguye kandi ata kintu na kimwe co kumunezereza yemeye ko bamuzanira, kandi biranka ko asinzira.
Hakiri mu mutwenzi, butaraca neza, umwami arazinduka yihutira kuja kuri rwa rwobo rw’intare.

Ashitse hafi y’urwo rwobo, ahamagara Daniyeli n’ijwi ririmwo umubabaro ati: “Daniyeli, musavyi w’Imana nzima, mbega Imana ukorera mu bwizigirwa, yoba yashoboye kukuzigama intare ntizigire ico zikugira?”
Daniyeli aramwishura ati: “Nyeningoma mwami, urakaramba!
Imana yanje yarungitse umumarayika wayo, yugara iminwa y’intare. Nta kintu zangize kuko nabonetse ko ata kibi nakoze imbere yayo, kandi ata n’ico nakoze imbere yawe, Nyeningoma.”
Umwami aca aranezerwa cane, atanga itegeko ngo bamukure muri urwo rwobo rw’intare. Kandi bamaze gukura Daniyeli muri ico kinogo, nta n’agakwabu kari ku mubiri wiwe, kuko yizigiye Imana yiwe.

Hanyuma, umwami aca atanga itegeko ko bafata ba bagabo bagira uwo mugambi wo gutega umutego Daniyeli; barabazana babaterera muri rwa rwobo rw’intare bari kumwe n’abagore babo n’abana babo. Intare zibasamira mu kirere, zibatabagura bataranashika hasi muri rwo, zivunagura amagufa yabo.
Ivyo biheze, umwami Dariyusi aca arungikira ubutumwa abantu bo mu moko yose n’ihanga ryose n’imvugo yose, baba kw’isi yose ati: “Amahoro no kuroranirwa bibane namwe mwese!”

“Ntanze itegeko ko mu bwami bwanje iyo buva bukagera abantu bose batinya kandi bagaha icubahiro Imana ya Daniyeli. Kuko ni Imana nzima kandi ibaho ibihe bidashira. Ingoma yayo ntizokwigera ikurwaho, kandi inganji yayo ntizokwigera irangira.
Iratabara, igakiza abantu bayo; ikora ibimenyetso n’utwumiza mw’ijuru no mw’isi. Yakijije Daniyeli ubushobozi bw’intare.”
Hanyuma Daniyeli akomeza gutera imbere igihe cose Dariyusi yamaze ku ngoma no ku ngoma ya Kuro umuperesi.

headings.text: Daniyeli atererwa mu rwobo rurimwo intare

verses.text: Mu mwaka wa mbere umwami Belushaza ari ku ngoma i Babiloni, Daniyeli yararose, kandi mu vyiyumviro vyiwe hacamwo ibintu vyinshi biza mu buryo bwo kwerekwa, aryamye ku buriri. Ivyo yarose yaravyanditse.
Daniyeli avuga ati: “Mu vyo neretswe mw’ijoro, nabonye imiyaga ivuye ku mpande zine z’isi yisuka mu kiyaga kinini.
Hanyuma, mbona ibikoko bininibinini bine bisokoroka biva mu kiyaga. Nta gikoko na kimwe casa n’ikindi.
Igikoko ca mbere casa n’intare, kandi cari gifise amababa y’inkona. Nkomeje kuraba, mbona amababa yaco aravunaguwe hanyuma gica gihagarara cemye kurya kw’umuntu kandi gihabwa kugira kamere k’umuntu.
Hanyuma nca mbona igikoko ca kabiri gisa n’idubu. Cari kiryamiye uruhande rumwe kandi gifise amagufa atatu y’imbavu mu kanwa, hagati y’amenyo. Numva ijwi rikibwira riti: ‘Vyuka, urye inyama nyinshi!’
Inyuma y’ivyo, nca mbona ikindi gikoko, casa n’ingwe. Ku mugongo cari gifise amababa ane nk’ay’inyoni, kikagira n’imitwe ine. Ico gikoko gihabwa ububasha bwo gutegeka.

Muri iryo joro, nkiriko nderekwa, mbona igikoko kigira kane: cari giteye ubwoba cane, kandi gikomeye rwose. Amenyo yaco yari manini kandi akozwe mu vyuma; carajanjagura ivyo cishe kikabirya, ibisigaye kikabisiribanga n’amaguru yaco. Cari gitandukanye cane n’ibindi bikoko kandi cari gifise amahembe cumi.

Nkiriko ndiyumvira ivyerekeye ayo mahembe yaco, nca mbona akandi gahembe gatoya gasokorotse hagati mu yandi mahembe kandi amahembe atatu aca akurwaho kugira ngo karonke ikibanza. Ako gahembe gatoya kari gafise amaso nk’ay’umuntu n’umunwa, kakavugana ubwibone.

Ndiko ndaraba, mbona intebe z’inganji zishirwa mu bibanza vyazo, hanyuma mbona uwusa n’Umukurambere, araje aricara. Impuzu ziwe, zarera derere, umushatsi wiwe ugasa n’ubwoya bw’intama bwera; Intebe yiwe yari igizwe n’imbeya z’umuriro, iteretswe ku mapine yaka urubeya.

Kandi uruzi rw’umuriro rwatemba ruva imbere yiwe. Abantu ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bari ngaho bamukorera; kandi ibihumbi cumi incuro ibihumbi cumi bari bahagaze ngaho bamushengereye. Urubanza ruratangura; hanyuma ibitabu birazingururwa.
Nkomeza kwitegereza, numva ka gahembe kariko kavuga amajambo y’ubwibone. Nshishikara kuraba kugeza aho ca gikoko ca kane cicwa, umuvyimba waco utererwa mw’itanure ry’umuriro uragitongora.
Vya bikoko bindi bitatu, ubutware bwavyo birabwakwa, ariko vyemererwa kuba birabayeho ikindi gihe.
Muri uko kwerekwa mw’ijoro, nkomeza kuraba ivyo ndiko nderekwa, ngize gutya mbona uwusa n’Umwana w’Umuntu aje azananye n’ibicu vyo kw’ijuru. Yegera wa mukurambere, ashikanwa imbere yiwe.

Aca ahabwa ububasha, ubwiza n’ubushobozi bwo kuganza; amahanga yose yo kw’isi, n’abavuga indimi zitandukanye baramutazira. Ukuganza kwiwe kuzohoraho ibihe bidashira kandi ingoma yiwe ntizokwigera ikurwaho.
Jewe Daniyeli, nca mpagarika umutima, kandi ivyo neretswe bituma mbura amahoro.
Nca negera umwe mu bari ngaho hafi y’iyo ntebe y’inganji ndamubaza ico ivyo bisigura. Nuko aca abinsobanurira gutya:
Birya bikoko binini cane bine, bisigura ubwami bune buzohaguruka bugatwara isi.
Ariko, kw’iherezo, abantu b’Imana Musumbavyose, ni bo bazohabwa ubwami, kandi bazoganza ibihe n’ibihe.

Hanyuma nca nipfuza kumenya ivyerekeye igikoko ca kane, kuko cari gitandukanye rwose n’ibindi kandi giteye ubwoba cane kubera ayo menyo yaco y’ivyuma hamwe n’inzara z’imwakaka. Ico gikoko ivyo cishe, caca kibijanjagura, kikarya ivyo cishe ibisigaye kikabisiribanga n’amaguru yaco.

Kandi ndasubira ndondera kumenya ivyerekeye amahembe cumi ari ku mutwe waco n’ivyerekeye ka gahembe kandi gatoya kameze mu nyuma kandi kagatuma atatu aca akoroka. Ako gahembe wamenga kabaye agahambaye kuruta ayo yandi kandi kakaba gafise amaso nk’umuntu n’umunwa uvuga amajambo y’ubwibone.
Nkiriko ndaraba, mbona ako gahembe kagwanya abera b’Imana kandi kakabanesha,
kugeza igihe wa mukurambere yaza, aca acira urubanza rwiza abatoranijwe b’Imana Musumbavyose, kuko igihe c’uko bahabwa ubwami cari kigeze.

Maze, aca aransobanurira ati: Kirya gikoko ca kane, ni ubwami bwa kane buzohaguruka kuganza isi. Buzoba butandukanye n’ubundi bwami bwabwitangiye imbere kandi buzotabagura isi yose, buyisiribange kandi buyijanjagure.
Amahembe yaco cumi, ni abami cumi bazotegeka ubwo bwami. Hanyuma uwundi mwami atandukanye n’abo cumi azokwima kandi azokuraho abami batatu.

Uwo mwami azovuga ibintu bibi ku Mana Musumbavyose, kandi azogirira nabi cane abera b’Imana, agerageze guhindura amabwirizwa y’Imana n’imisi mikuru yashinzwe. Abera b’Imana bazoshirwa mu maboko yiwe ikiringo kingana n’igihe, n’ibihe bibiri, hamwe n’igice c’igihe.
Ariko, mu nyuma ubucamanza buzomucira urubanza, n’ubushobozi bwose abwakwe, hanyuma arandurwe ibihe vyose.

Ni ho ukuganza, ubushobozi, no gushirwa hejuru kwose kw’ubwami buri musi y’izuba buzohabwa abera b’Iyisumbavyose. Ubwami bwiwe buzokwamaho ibihe bidashira, kandi abatware bose bazomutazira bamwumvire.
Aho ni ho ukwerekwa kwagarukiye. Jewe, Daniyeli, nagize ubwoba bwinshi kubera ivyiyumviro vyinshi bivuye ku vyo neretswe, mu maso hanje hariraburanirwa, ariko ndabigumiza mu mutima wanje.”
Mu mwaka ugira gatatu umwami Belushaza ari ku ngoma, jewe Daniyeli nongeye kwerekwa ibindi, bikurikira ivyo nari mperutse kubona.
Muri ukwo kwerekwa, nabona ndi i Suza, igisagara gikomeye c’i Babiloni co mu ntara yitwa Elamu; muri ukwo kwerekwa mbona mpagaze impande y’Uruzi rwitwa Ulayi.

Ngize gutya, mbona impfizi y’intama ifise amahembe abiri, ihagaze i ruhande y’urwo ruzi, kandi ayo mahembe yari maremare. Ihembe rimwe ryari rirerire gusumba irindi, ariko mu nyuma na ryo n’irindi naryo rirakura.

Iyo mpfizi y’intama igenda iraseka itumbereye mu burengero, mu buraruko no mu bumanuko. Nta gikoko na kimwe cari gikomeye ku buryo coshoboye kuyihangara, kandi nta kintu na kimwe cashobora kunanira ubushobozi bwayo. Yakora uko ishaka, mbere igera aho iba agahambaye cane.

Nkiriko ndavyiyumvirako, ubwo nyene nca mbona impfizi y’impene ifise ihembe rimwe hagati y’amaso, ije ivuye mu burengero, mbona igendagenda kw’isi yose kandi ikanyaruka ku buryo wamenga amaguru ntiyakora no hasi.
Igenda itumbereye ya mpfizi y’intama nari nabonye ihagaze i ruhande y’uruzi, yiruka iyitumbereye ifise uburake bwinshi.

Mbona iyigwanya n’ishavu ryinshi, iseka iyo ntama ivuna ya mahembe yompi. Iyo mpfizi y’intama nta bushobozi yari igifise bwo kugwana n’iyo mpfizi y’impene, iyikubita hasi irayisiribanga. Nta muntu n’umwe yari gushobora gutabara iyo mpfizi y’intama ngo ayikure mu maboko y’iyo mpfizi y’impene.
Iyo mpfizi y’impene ica iba agahambaye. Ariko igeze aho ikomera cane, rya hembe ryayo rirerire riravunika. Mu kibanza c’iryo hembe rirerire, hamera ayandi mahembe ane atumbereye impande zine z’isi.
Maze, mu kibanza c’ihembe rimwe muri ayo, hamera ihembe ritoya ariko rica rirakomera rigira ububasha bwinshi butumbereye mu bumanuko, mu buseruko no mu gihugu ciza Isirayeli.
Ako gahembe karakomera gashikira amajuru, kugeza aho kagwanya ingabo zo kw’ijuru, kandi zimwe muri zo kazikubita hasi, karazisiribanga.
Mbere kagwanya umukuru w’ingabo zo mw’ijuru mu kubuza abantu kumuha ibimazi no mu gusambura urusengero rwiwe.
Ingabo zo mw’ijuru zirabujijwe kuja kugwanya ubwo bugarariji. Maze, ikimazi gitangwa imisi yose nticaba kigitangwa, ukuri nakwo kurahonyangwa. Ako gahembe kagira intsinzi mu vyo kakora vyose.

Hanyuma numva abera babiri bo mw’ijuru bavugana, umwe abaza mugenziwe ati: “Mbega ivyo vyerekanywe bizofata igihe kingana iki? Ivyerekanywe vyerekeye umugararizo utuma ikimazi cama gitangwa ku musi ku musi, gihagarikwa hamwe no guhumanya urusengero? Urusengero n’abantu b’Imana bizoba musi y’ububasha bw’ako gahembe kugeza ryari no gusiribangirwa musi y’ibirenge vyako?”
Uwundi aramwishura ati: “Kugira ngo urusengero ruhumanurwe kandi rwongere gukora, hazoca amajoro n’ibitondo ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana atatu.”
Igihe nariko nderekwa ngerageza gutahura ivyo mbonye ivyo ari vyo, nabonye uwusa n’umuntu aje ahagaze imbere yanje.
Kandi ngaho impande y’uruzi Ulayi, hava ijwi rimeze nk’iry’umuntu rivuga riti: “Gaburiyeli, bwira uwo mugabo insobanuro y’ivyo yeretswe.”
Maze Gaburiyeli yegereye aho nari mpagaze, ngira ubwoba bwinshi nca nikubita hasi nubamye. Aca arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, tahura ko ivyo weretswe vyerekeye igihe c’iherezo.”
Akiriko aravuga, nca ncika intege, ngwa hasi nubamye. Ariko Gaburiyeli ankorako, aramvyura arampagarika.
Hanyuma aca ambwira ati: “Ngiye kukubwira ibizoba hanyuma mu gihe Imana izokwerekana uburake bwayo, kuko ivyo weretswe vyerekeye igihe cashinzwe c’iherezo.
Amahembe abiri y’intama asobanura abami b’Abamedi n’Abaperesi.
Impfizi y’impene na yo, isobanura ubwami bw’Abagiriki, ihembe rirerire ryayo riri hagati y’amaso risigura umwami wa mbere w’ubwo bwami bw’Abagiriki.
Amahembe ane yasubiriye rimwe ryavunika, yerekana ko ubwo bwami bw’Abagiriki buzogabanganywa, havemwo ubwami bune, ariko ntibuzoba bukomeye nka bumwe bwa mbere.
Ubwo bwami bugiye kurangira, igihe ibicumuro vyabwo bizoba vyuzuye, hari uwundi mwami azokwima, azoba ari inkozi y’ikibi kandi ari indyarya.
Azokomera cane, ariko bitavuye ku bushobozi bwiwe. Azokwica ibintu vyinshi kandi ivyo agomba gukora vyose azobishikako. Azotikiza abarongozi bakomeye kandi yice abera b’Imana.

Ibinyoma vyiwe bizotuma ashishikara kuja imbere, bitume yishira hejuru; kandi azokwica abantu benshi giturumbuka yongere agwanye Umwami w’abami, mu nyuma azovunagurwa, ariko bitavuye ku nkomezi z’umuntu.
Ivyo weretswe vyerekeye amajoro n’ibitondo ni ukuri. Ariko ubigire ibanga kuko bizoba haciye igihe kirekire.”

Hanyuma, jewe Daniyeli nca numva ncitse intege. Ndakumbagara, mara imisi myinshi ngwaye. Maze mu nyuma ndavyuka, nkora ibikorwa nari njejwe gukorera umwami. Ariko nari mbabajwe cane n’ivyo neretswe kuko ntashobora kwumva neza ivyo ari vyo.

headings.text: Daniyeli yerekwa impfizi y’intama n’impfizi y’impene

verses.text: Mu mwaka wa mbere umwami Dariyusi Umumedi mwene Ahasuwerusi, agiye ku ngoma, ngo abe umwami w’i Babiloni,

muri uwo mwaka wa mbere w’ingoma yiwe nyene, jewe Daniyeli natahujwe n’ivyo nsomye mw’Ijambo ry’Uhoraho, nk’uko uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya yabihishuriwe, rivuga ko Yerusalemu hazomara imyaka mirongo indwi ari umusaka.
Nca mpindukirira Uhoraho Imana, ntangura gutakamba ndayisenga nongera ndayinginga, nisonzesheje, nambaye amagunira kandi nisize iminyota.
Nsenga Uhoraho Imana yanje kandi ndatura nti: “Ewe Uhoraho, Mana nkuru kandi uhambaye, wama ushitsa kandi ukazigama amasezerano y’urukundo ukunda abagukunda bakitondera ivyagezwe vyawe;
twaracumuye kandi twakoze ibibi. Twarakugararije ntitwubaha amabwirizwa n’amategeko yawe.
Ntitwumviye abakozi bawe ari bo bavugishwa, bavuga mw’izina ryawe babwira abami bacu n’abaganwa bacu, ba sogokuruza hamwe n’abantu bose bo mu gihugu.

Ewe Mana, wewe uragororotse, ariko uwu musi twuzuye ibimaramare. Ni ko biri ku Bayuda, ku baba i Yerusalemu no ku Bisirayeli bose, abari hafi n’abari kure, iyo bari mu bihugu vyose wabashwiragijemwo bitewe n’ukubura ubwizigirwa imbere yawe.
Twebwe n’abami bacu, abaganwa na ba sogokuruza, twese twuzuye ibimaramare kuko twagucumuyeko.
Ariko Uhoraho Imana yacu, uri umunyakigongwe none tugirire imbabazi, naho twakugararije.
Ntitwumviye Uhoraho Imana yacu, kuko tutakurikiye amabwirizwa yaduhaye biciye ku bakozi biwe ari bo bavugishwa.
Abisirayeli bose bararenze ku vyagezwe vyawe, barahindukira, banka kukwumvira. Ni co gituma imivumo yose hamwe n’imanza zanditswe mu Vyagezwe vy’umusavyi wawe Mose, vyadusutsweko, kuko twagucumuyeko.
Washikije ivyo wari waravuze ko uzodukorera twebwe n’abatware bacu mu kudushitsako icago kinini gutya. Kw’isi yose, nta na hamwe higeze haba ivyago nk’ivyabaye i Yerusalemu.

Nk’uko vyanditswe mu Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe vya Mose, ibi vyago vyose vyadushitseko, ariko ntitwigeze turondera ukugirirwa neza n’ Uhoraho Imana yacu mu guhindukira no mu kuva mu vyaha vyacu tugashira umutima ku kuri kwayo.
Wewe Uhoraho ntiwatevye kutuzanako ibi vyago kuko wewe Uhoraho Imana yacu ugororotse mu vyo ukora vyose; natwe tukaba twaranse kukwumvira.
Uhoraho Mana yacu, wewe wakuye abantu bawe muri Egiputa ukoresheje ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi, ukironkera izina ryama ryibukwa kugeza uyu musi, twaragucumuyeko, twakoze ibibi.

Ewe Mana, mu gukomeza ibikorwa vyawe vy’ukugororoka, kura ishavu ryawe n’uburake bwawe kuri Yerusalemu, igisagara cawe, umusozi wawe watoranije. Ivyaha vyacu hamwe n’ibigabitanyo vya ba sogokuruza vyatumye Yerusalemu n’abantu bawe, bashinyagurirwa n’abahakikuje bose.
Ewe Uhoraho Mana yacu, wumve ugusenga n’ukwinginga kw’umusavyi wawe. Ku bw’icubahiro cawe Mana, rabana imbabazi urusengero rwawe rwahindutse umusaka.

Ewe Mana yacu, tega ugutwi unyumve. Utereze inyonga zawe witegereze ukuntu igisagara citirirwa izina ryawe casanganguwe. Ntitugutakambiye kubera tugororotse, ahubwo ni kubera imbabazi zawe ari nyinshi.
Uhoraho utwumvirize! Uhoraho utubabarire. Ewe Uhoraho, niwumve wongere ukore! Ku bw’icubahiro cawe, ntutebe, ewe Mana, ku bw’abantu bawe n’igisagara cawe vyitirirwa izina ryawe.”
Nkiriko ndavuga nongera nsenga, natura ivyaha vyanje n’ivyaha vy’ubwoko bwanje bw’Abisirayeli, nsaba Uhoraho Imana yanje nsabira umusozi wayo wejejwe,
nkiriko ndasenga, Gaburiyeli, umwe nari nabonye mw’iyerekwa rya mbere, aza aho ndi anyaruka, hari nk’igihe co gutanga ikimazi co ku mugoroba.
Arambarira ati: “Daniyeli, nzanywe no kukwungura ubwenge no kugufasha gutahura.”
Kuva ugitangura gusenga, hatanzwe itegeko ari na ryo rinzanye, kuko uri uw’igiciro mu nyonga z’Imana. Wumvirize neza kugira ngo ushobore gutahura ico ivyo weretswe bivuga.

Igihe kingana n’amayinga mirongo indwi y’imyaka, ni co cashinzwe ku bw’abantu bawe n’igisagara catoranijwe kugira ngo barangize ubugarariji bwabo, n’ivyaha vyabo bihongerwe, haze ubugororotsi bw’Imana butazoshira, ivyavuzwe n’abavugishwa n’Imana hamwe n’ivyo beretswe bishike, hanyuma Ahera Cane h’urusengero hongere hahumanurwe.

Ubu rero, umviriza kandi utahure: kuva igihe itegeko ryo gusubira kwubaka Yerusalemu rizosohokera, hazohera amayinga indwi y’imyaka agwije incuro indwi, hanyuma habe ayandi mayinga mirongo itandatu n’abiri y’imyaka, hanyuma haze umurongozi yasizwe amavuta. Igisagara ca Yerusalemu kizokwubakwa hamwe n’amabarabara yaho, mugabo bizokorwa mu bihe bigoye cane.

“Inyuma y’ayo mayinga mirongo itandatu n’abiri, uwasizwe amavuta azokwicwa, mu buryo bw’akarenganyo. Inyuma y’aho, ingabo zo mu bwoko bw’umutware w’umunyamahanga azoza zizosangangura igisagara n’urusengero. Umuhero uzoza nk’umwuzure w’amazi, kandi kuva ico gihe intambara n’ivyago bizokomeza kugeza kw’iherezo ry’ibihe.

Uwo mutware azoza, azogirana amasezerano n’abantu benshi mu kiringo c’imyaka indwi, ariko ico gihe kigeze hagati, azokuraho ivyo gutanga ibimazi n’amashikanwa. Kugira ngo ibikorwa vyiwe bibi vyuzure, azoshinga mu rusengero ikintu kizira, bitume urusengero ruhumana, bizoguma gutyo kugeza aho iherezo ryiwe rizoshikira nk’uko vyashinzwe.”

Mu mwaka ugira gatatu, umwami Kuro w’Ubuperesi ari ku ngoma, hariho ibindi Daniyeli (ari we bise Beluteshaza) yeretswe. Ubutumwa yaronse bwari ubw’ukuri kandi bwari bwerekeye ibihe vy’intambara ihambaye. Daniyeli yumviriza cane ivyo abwiwe hanyuma abitahuzwa n’ivyo yeretswe.
Ico gihe, Jewe Daniyeli, namaze amayinga atatu yose ngandaye.
Nta vyokurya vyiza canke inyama nafungura, nta n’umuvinyu nanywa kandi nta n’amavuta nisiga mu maso canke mu mutwe kugeza ayo mayinga atatu aheze.
Ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere, nari mpagaze ku nkombe y’uruzi runini Tigiri,
nunamuye amaso, mbona umuntu yambaye impuzu zikayangana, afise mu rukenyerero umukanda w’inzahabu ziva muri Ufazi.

Umubiri wiwe wasa n’akabuye k’igiciro kinini kitwa topazi, mu maso hiwe hakaravya nk’imiravyo, kandi amaso yiwe yamurika kurya kw’amatara, amaboko n’amaguru vyiwe, vyarakayangana kurya kw’umwakaka iyo wasenywe neza, kandi ijwi ryiwe ryasamirana nk’amajwi y’abantu isinzi.
Jewe Daniyeli ni jewe jenyene nabonye ivy’iryo yerekwa, abagabo twari kumwe nta na kimwe babonye, ariko bagize ubwoba bwinshi baca bariruka kwinyegeza.
Nasigaye ngaho jenyene, ndaba iryo yerekwa ry’igitangaza. Nta nkomezi na nkeya nari ngifise, mu maso hanje hariraburanirwa hasa n’ah’uwapfuye kandi ngira intege nke cane.
Mu nyuma numvise wa muntu avuga, kandi numvise ugusamirana kw’ijwi ryiwe, nca ncika intege nikubita hasi nubamye.
Numva ukuboko kuje kunkorako kuramvyura, ndapfukama kandi nshira ibiganza hasi, ariko nari ngihinda agashitsi.
Hanyuma wa muntu arambwira ati: “Daniyeli, wa muntu we w’igiciro kinini, umviriza neza ivyo ngomba kukubwira, kandi haguruka, kuko nagutumweko.” Amaze kumbwira ivyo, nca ndahaguruka mpinda agashitsi.

Maze aca arabandanya ati: “Daniyeli, ntutinye. Kuva umusi wa mbere watanguriyeko gusenga usaba gutahura kandi wicishije bugufi imbere y’Imana yawe, amajambo yawe yarumvikanye mw’ijuru, none nje nkuzaniye inyishu y’amasengesho yawe.

Ariko impwemu itegeka ubwami bw’Ubuperesi yaranzibiye imisi mirongo ibiri n’umwe. Hanyuma Mikaheli, umwe mu bamarayika bakuru, aca araza kuntabara, kuko ni ho nari mbohewe n’umutware w’ubwami bw’Ubuperesi.
None rero, nzanywe no kukumenyesha ibizoba ku bwoko bwawe muri kazoza, kuko iyerekwa wagize ryerekeye igihe kizoza.”
Akiriko arambwira, nca nunamika amaso, biranka n’uko mvuga.

Hanyuma umwe asa n’umuntu aca ankora ku minwa, nca nshobora guteranura akanwa no kuvuga. Nca mbwira umwe ahagaze imbere yanje nti: “Mwami wanje, erega nuzuye umubabaro kubera ivyo neretswe, kandi mfise intege nke cane.
Mbega Mwami wanje, umusavyi wawe nkanje yoshobora kugira ico akubwiye? Inkomezi zamvuyemwo, ndetse no guhema birangora.”
Umwe asa n’umuntu arongera ankorako, nca numva inkomezi ziragarutse.

Arambwira ati: “Nta co utinya, kuko uri uw’igiciro kinini ku Mana. Gira amahoro! Komera! Komera!” Ariko arambwira ayo majambo, ubwo nyene nca numva ngize inguvu nca ndamubwira nti: “Mwami wanje, ndagusavye umbwire ndakwumva kuko wanyongeye inkomezi.”
Nuko aca ambwira ati: “Mbega urazi icatumye nza? Ubu ngira nsubire kugwana n’impwemu itegeka Ubuperesi, kandi maze kurengana, impwemu itegeka Ubugiriki izoca iza.
Ariko ngira ndakubwire ivyanditswe mu Gitabu c’Ukuri. Muri urwo rugamba nta n’umwe antabara kiretse Mikaheli, umumarayika wanyu.”
Kandi mu mwaka wa mbere Dariyusi Umumedi ari ku ngoma, nari kumwe na we ndamutera intege.

“Ubu rero ngomba ndakumenyeshe ukuri kwose: Hari abandi bami batatu b’Ubuperesi bazoza, hanyuma bakurikirwe n’uwa kane, uwo azoba atunze kubarusha bose. Azokoresha ubutunzi bwiwe kugira ngo ahere umuntu wese yomufasha kugwanya ubwami bw’Abagiriki.
Maze hazoca haza umwami akomeye azoganzanya ububasha bwinshi, akore ico agomba cose.

Ariko ashitse ku kunengesera kw’ugukomera kw’ubwami bwiwe, ubwo bwami buzosambuka bwigabanyemwo ubwami bune. Abami batamukomokako ni bo bazoganza ubwo bwami, ariko ntibazogira ububasha nk’ubwo yari afise. Kuko iyo ngoma izorandurwa igahabwa abandi.
Umwami wo mu bumanuko azokomera, ariko umwe mu ngabo ziwe azomurusha inguvu, ace aganza ubundi bwami bwiwe mu bubasha bwinshi.

Inyuma y’imyaka mikeya hazoba amasezerano hagati y’umwami wo mu bumanuko n’umwami wo mu buraruko. Umukobwa w’umwami wo mu bumanuko azorongorwa n’umwami wo mu buraruko kugira ngo bakomeze ayo masezerano. Ariko uwo mukobwa ntazozigama ububasha bwiwe, ndetse n’uwo mwami n’ububasha bwiwe ntibizorama. Azokwicanwa n’uwamuzanye, na se wiwe, hamwe n’uwuzoba amushigikiye.
Umwe mu ncuti z’uwo mukobwa azohaguruka asubire mu gishingo c’umwami. Azotegura ingabo, agende asange umwami wo mu buraruko mu bwihisho bwiwe amutsindeho.
Asubiye muri Egiputa, azosubiranayo ibigirwamana vyabo hamwe n’ubutunzi bwinshi bw’inzahabu n’ifeza. Inyuma y’imyaka mikeya, azoreka umwami wo mu buraruko.
Igihe kanaka giheze, umwami wo mu buraruko azotera ikirimba c’ubwami bwo mu bumanuko, ariko azoca asubira iwe vuba.
Abahungu b’umwami wo mu buraruko, bazokwegeranya ingabo zikomeye zizosendanisha nk’umwuzure bagwane kugeza bashitse aho umwansi yihisha.
Inyuma y’aho, umwami wo mu bumanuko azohagurukana ishavu ryinshi, yegeranye ingabo nyinshi aje kugwanya za ngabo nyinshi zegeranijwe n’umwami wo mu buraruko, azitsinde.
Inyuma y’iyo ntsinzi azogira ubwibone bwinshi, yice ingabo nyinshi z’abansi biwe. Ariko intsinzi yiwe ntizorama.
Inyuma y’imyaka mikeya, umwami wo mu buraruko azomanuka afise ingabo nyinshi kandi zifise ibigwanisho kurusha ubwa mbere.

Ico gihe, hazoba abantu benshi bahagurukiye umwami wo mu bumanuko ngo bamurwanye, mbere n’abantu b’abagwanyi bo mu bwoko bwawe bazokwifatanya na bo kugira ngo bashitse ivyo iyerekwa ryavuze ariko ntibazobishobora.
Mu nyuma umwami wo mu buraruko azoza yugarize igisagara kizitijwe inzitiro z’amabuye, agifate. Ingabo zo mu bumanuko n’ubwo zikerebutse mu kugwana, ntizizoshobora guhagarara imbere yiwe.
Umwami wo mu buraruko azogenda umuraramango ata wumugwanya; nta n’umwe azoshobora kumuhagarara imbere. Azohagarara mu gihugu c’ubwiza ca Isirayeli, agomba kugisambura.

Azogerageza gushiramwo inguvu z’ubwami bwiwe zose kandi agirane amasezerano n’umwami wo mu bumanuko, amushingire umukobwa wiwe kugira ngo iyo ngoma ayisenyure mu bwenge aciye imbere muri yo, ariko iyo migabo yiwe nta co izoshikako.
Inyuma y’ivyo, azohindukirira amazinga kandi yigarurire menshi, ariko umukuru w’ingabo avuye mu kindi gihugu azomucisha bugufi atume asubira iwe amaramara.
Ashitse azokwinyegeza mu bwihisho bwiwe, hanyuma atsitare atembe, nta wuzokwongera kumubona.
Umusubirizi wiwe azotuma abatozakori kugira ngo ingoma yiwe igumane icubahiro. Ariko, amaze imisi mikeya ku ngoma, azopfa, yamara ntazoba yishwe n’uburake bw’umuntu canke n’intambara.
Uwuzoza mu nyuma, azoba ari umuntu akengeretse kandi atari mu nda y’ingoma. Azoza ata wumwiteze kandi afate ingoma akoresheje urwenge n’uruhendo.
Ingabo nyinshi zizogwa imbere yiwe, harimwo n’umuganwa wo mu bwoko bufise isezerano.
Azokoresha amasezerano menshi arimwo uruhendo. Naho abamushigikiye bazoba ari bake, azoguma akomera.

Igihe intara zitunze cane zizoba zibereyeho ata co zinona, azozitera ashitse ivyo ba se canke ba sekuru batigeze bakora. Azofata ubutunzi yasahuye, abugabanganye abamushigikiye. Azogira imigabo yo gusenyura ahari ubwihisho bukomeye, ariko ivyo bizomara igihe gito.
Mu nyuma, azokwihagararako yegeranye ingabo zikomeye zo kugwanya umwami wo mu bumanuko, hanyuma uwo na we azoja kumugwanya n’ingabo zikomeye, ariko nta co azoshikako kuko abandi bantu bazomuryaruka.
Abantu bo mu nzu y’uwo mwami wo mu bumanuko ni bo bazotuma atemba, ingabo ziwe zishwiragire kandi ingabo nyinshi zizogwa ku rugamba.
Abo bami babiri bazokwicarana ku meza bafise imitima ihengamiye ku kibi, maze bahendane; ariko nta kizovamwo kuko iherezo rizoshika igihe cashinzwe gishitse.
Umwami wo mu buraruko azosubira iwe afise ubutunzi bwinshi. Ari ku nzira, azosotora abantu bafise isezerano n’Imana, kandi azokwonona vyinshi imbere yo gushika iwe.
Igihe gikwiye gishitse, azosubira atere mu bumanuko, ariko ico gihe ibintu ntibizomera nka mbere.

Kuko amato y’intambara avuye mu burengero y’i Kitimu azomutera ubwoba, hanyuma abireke asubire iwe. Ariko ishavu ryiwe azorita ku bantu bafitaniye isezerano n’Imana kandi acudike n’abataye iryo sezerano.
Ingabo ziwe zizokwigarurira ubwihisho bw’urusengero, bazokwanduza ahera h’urusengero, kandi babuze ko ibimazi vyo ku musi bitangwa, yongere akore ikizira gihumanya urusengero.
Azokoresha urwenge n’uruhendo yikwegereko abavuye mw’isezerano ry’Imana. Ariko abantu bazi neza Imana yabo bazokomera kandi bamugwanye.
Abarongozi baciye ubwenge bazokwigisha benshi, ariko kandi bamwe bazokwicishwa inkota, abandi baturirwe, abandi na bo bapfungwe bongere banyagwe ivyabo.
Muri ivyo bihe vy’ihamwa, nta wuzobatabara, kandi n’abazokwerekana ko bari kumwe na bo bazoba babikora mu buryarya.
Mu banyabwenge b’ico gihe, bamwe bazohitanwa n’iryo hamwa. Gutyo bazokwezwa batunganywe kugeza ku gihe c’iherezo, kuko igihe cashinzwe kitarashika.

Umwami azokora ivyo yishakiye, yishire hejuru avuga ko ari agahambaye hejuru y’icitwa imana cose, mbere atuke Imana isumba ivyitwa imana vyose. Azokora ivyo ashaka vyose, ariko kugeza aho igihe cashinzwe ko uburake bumushikako kizoshikira, kuko ivyashinzwe, nta kabuza bizoshika.
Ntazokwubaha imana za ba sekuruza, canke imana ikundwa n’abagore canke imana iyo ari yo yose, kuko azokwishira hejuru akavuga ko azisumba zose.
Mu gishingo cazo, azosenga imana ikingira ibisagara, imana ba sekuruza batigeze bamenya, azoyishikanira inzahabu, ifeza, amabuye y’agaciro hamwe n’izindi ngabire z’igiciro kinini.
Mu kwerekana ko ico kigirwamana camufashije, azotera ahantu hakomeye ho kwihisha. Azoha icubahiro abemeye kumusaba, abashire mu bibanza vy’icubahiro hanyuma abagaburire igihugu nk’impera abahaye.

Mu gihe ca nyuma, umwami wo mu bumanuko azotera umwami wo mu buraruko. Umwami wo mu buraruko azomushikako kurya kw’igihuhusi afise imikogote, abagwanira ku mafarasi n’ubwato. Azotera ibihugu vyinshi kandi imbibe zavyo azozirenga kurya kw’uruzi rusheshe.
Azoshika mu gihugu c’ubwiza ari co Isirayeli, kandi amahanga menshi azomwikubita imbere, ariko Mowabu, Edomu n’igice kinini c’Abamoni bizomukira.
Azokwigarurira ibihugu vyinshi, kandi na Egiputa ntikizomukira.
Azoganza inzahabu, ifeza, hamwe n’ubutunzi bwa Egiputa kandi abo muri Libiya n’abo muri Etiyopiya bazomukorera.
Ariko inkuru zivuye mu buseruko no mu buraruko zizomutera ubwoba, azoca agira uburake bwinshi agende kugeseza abantu benshi.
Azohagarara hagati y’umusozi watoranijwe n’ikiyaga, ahashinge amahema yiwe. Ariko, igihe azoba akiri ngaho, ukubaho kwiwe kuzorangira vuba, kandi nta muntu azoronka wo kumutabara.

headings.text: Abami bo mu bumanuko n’abo mu buraruko

verses.text: Maze ico gihe, Mikaheli, umumarayika ahambaye w’ubwoko bwawe, azohaguruka. Hanyuma hazoba ibihe vy’umubabaro bikomeye kurusha ivyigeze kubaho kuva amahanga abayeho. Ariko, muri ico gihe, uwo mu bwoko bwanyu azoba yanditswe mu gitabu c’Imana azorokoka.
Benshi mu bari mu mva bapfuye, bazozuka, bamwe bazozukira ubugingo budashira, abandi na bo bazukire ibimaramare n’ibiteterwe vy’ibihe bidashira.
Abagize ubwenge bazokwakaka nk’umuco wo kw’ijuru, kandi abashikanye benshi ku kugororoka bazokwakaka nk’inyenyeri ibihe bidashira.
Ariko, wewe Daniyeli, igitabu c’ubu buhanuzi ukigire ibanga, ucugare kugeza igihe c’iherezo gishitse. Abantu bazoja hirya no hino kugira ngo barondere kugwiza ubumenyi.”
Maze, Jewe Daniyeli, ndongera ndaraba, mbona imbere yanje hari abandi bantu babiri bahagaze ku yindi nkombe y’uruzi, umwe ari ku nkombe yo hakuno, uwundi ari ku yo hakurya.
Umwe muri bo, abaza wa wundi yari yambaye impuzu zikayangana kandi yari ahagaze hejuru ku mazi y’urwo ruzi, ati: “Mbega hazoca igihe kingana iki kugira ngo ivyo bintu bikomeye gutyo bishike?”

Uwo muntu yambaye impuzu zikayangana ahagaze hejuru y’uruzi, atumbereza amaboko yiwe yose mw’ijuru, aca arahira Iyibaho ibihe bidashira, avuga ati: “Bizomara igihe, ibihe, n’igice c’igihe. Igihe inkomezi z’ubwoko bw’Imana zizoba zirangiye, n’ivyo vyose bizoba biheze.”
Numva ivyo avuze, ariko sinabitahura, hanyuma nca ndabaza nti: “Mwami wanje, ivyo vyose bizorangira gute?”
Aca aranyishura ati: “Daniyeli, niwigire kuko ayo majambo azoguma ari ibanga rihishijwe kugeza igihe c’iherezo.

Benshi bazotunganywa, bezwe kandi batyororwe n’ivyo bihe vy’imibabaro. Ariko abanyakibi bo bazokomeza gukora ibibi, kandi nta n’umwe muri bo azogira ico atahura. Abagize ubwenge bonyene ni bo bazobitahura.
Kuva bahagaritse gutanga ikimazi gitangwa ku musi kandi ikizira gihumanya kigashingwa ngo gisengwe, hazoba hasigaye imisi igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo icenda.
Bazoba bahiriwe abantu bazoshobora kurindira gushika ku musi ugira igihumbi n’amajana atatu na mirongo itatu n’itanu.
Wewe Daniyeli, komeza ube umwizigirwa gushitsa kw’iherezo. Uzoruhuka, hanyuma ku mpera y’ibihe, uzovyuka kugira ngo uhabwe impera yawe wateguriwe.”
